input: startPos, endPos and k are integers in [1,1000]. Steps are left/right by one on the entire integer line, including negative positions. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. Python integer inputs are plain int, excluding bool.
return: Number of ordered sequences of exactly k steps ending at endPos, modulo 1000000007.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Distance/parity checks make chosen=(k-distance)/2 an integer. Pascal additions remain below 2M and are reduced immediately. Descending indices preserve the prior binomial row. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(k*(chosen+1)+1) time and O(chosen+1) auxiliary space, with O(1) early rejection. No arbitrary-precision factorial or unchecked modular product. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 531 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used.
